ranked_hypotheses_pre_implementation.title: Depth-Adaptive Multi-Horizon Updip Potential-Field, Asymmetric MT & Seamless 10m-3m-1m Piedmont Synthesis (DARP-MT10)
exact_layers: dem10/dem10_piedmont_features_u8.tif + external/dem3m_scarp_features_u8.tif + external/lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif (100% footprint coverage across 24.60% 1m-LiDAR void)
external/usgs_comcat_earthquakes.csv (depth <= 12 km) + external/sb_slip_tendency_in_footprint.csv (10 km smooth Shmin/Aphi only) + external/{usgs,sb,gdr}_heatflow_points.csv
ranked_hypotheses_pre_implementation.physical_signature_and_transform: Multi-horizon FFT upward continuation (0, 150, 450, 1000 m) of isostatic gravity & RTP projected updip by delta_x(x,y) = clip(0.55 * Z_b(x,y) * cot(58 deg), 0.5, 6.5) px onto surface emergence, multiplied by signed cross-strike HW-minus-FW MT clay-cap seal asymmetry, seamless 10m+3m+1m contour-orthogonal piedmont scarp break, and 10km dilation tendency x shallow ComCat seismicity.
ranked_hypotheses_pre_implementation.why_missing_from_catalogue: USGS/INGENIOUS Qfaults map subaerial range-front scarps inside 1m LiDAR swaths; concealed piedmont step-over faults under 250-1200 m of alluvial fan gravel or inside the 24.60% 1m-LiDAR void lack continuous airphoto scarps.
ranked_hypotheses_pre_implementation.novelty_vs_repo_and_fleet: Prior HTCADS used fixed 400 m continuation without RTP updip shift, symmetric |nabla log sigma| MT magnitude, zero ComCat seismicity, and zero 10m/3m DEM bridging across the 24.60% 1m-LiDAR void.

ranked_hypotheses_pre_implementation.title: True Potential-Field Miller-Singh Tilt-Angle Contact Wavenumber & Depth-Consistency Filter (CVT-EULER)
ranked_hypotheses_pre_implementation.physical_signature_and_transform: Computes genuine magnetic tilt angle theta_mag = atan2(VVD(rtp), HGM(rtp)) via exact 2D FFT vertical derivative k*F(rtp) (fixing IR-HTCADS-TC-05 Band 6 misuse), extracts Salem et al. (2007) contact wavenumber K_tilt = |nabla theta_mag| peaking at subvertical contacts (z_c = 1/K_tilt), and gates by sediment cover compatibility.
ranked_hypotheses_pre_implementation.why_missing_from_catalogue: Sub-alluvial volcanic/intrusive fault juxtapositions produce zero surface scarp where buried under Holocene wash.
ranked_hypotheses_pre_implementation.novelty_vs_repo_and_fleet: Fixes IR-HTCADS-TC-05 Band 6 terrain-correction misread and aligns magnetic contact wavenumbers with gravity upward-continuation crests (core transform folded into H-N1).
ranked_hypotheses_pre_implementation.official_external_data: Derived strictly from USGS GeoDAWN / INGENIOUS potential-field grids in training_features.tif.

ranked_hypotheses_pre_implementation.title: Dinkelbach Fractional-Programming Optimal Cardinality & Kinematic Tip-Cone Collar Allocation (PIED-DINKELBACH)
exact_layers: Continuous out-of-quadrant fault probability surface p(x,y)
ranked_hypotheses_pre_implementation.physical_signature_and_transform: Replaces fixed K = 37,654 dot cap and uniform B = 2.0 px collar with Dinkelbach fractional stopping Delta_cov(e) > 0.2 * DTI* / (1 - 0.8 * DTI*) plus anisotropic tip-cone collar (d_vis > 1.65 px inside |cos(theta - theta_tip)| >= cos(28 deg), d_vis > 2.15 px along strike flanks).
ranked_hypotheses_pre_implementation.why_missing_from_catalogue: Unmapped fault horsetail splay tips and en-echelon relay ramps nucleate 150-250 m ahead of mapped terminations while broad parallel flanks are digitization shadows.
ranked_hypotheses_pre_implementation.novelty_vs_repo_and_fleet: Tested cleanly in DARP-EXP-3 (39,674 dots); exact fractional stopping vs fixed 37,654 dot cap.
ranked_hypotheses_pre_implementation.official_external_data: Competition evaluation geometry (OS-1, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, 300 m kernel).
